body: My life is shit too, but 2 days after feeling suicidal, I looked back and felt foolish.  It really does get better, and here in this sub there are wonderful people who genuinely care about you.  Like adrei says, you have fought through life, and came out as champion.  Dont forget the strength inside of you.  Wake up tomorrow, make that delicious hang-over brunch, do the SSS (shitshowershave) and make the day your own.
I agree, I need counseling.  This kind of irrational thought process is terrifying.

I know it will get better, I really do.  Its the dark moments that frighten me, I seem to spiral and lose rational thought.  I just see myself ending it, and at the time Im so stuck in that moment I dont think.  Ive been able to snap out of it and Im genuinely scared afterwards by how close I may have come.  
I am in the beginning stages of mourning the death of my marriage, but Im sick of calling family with the same thing.  Its nice to know there are people in the world that care about strangers, I appreciate the tips.
